original.contentChecks: Checked that the file type matches its contents and scanned for embedded executables and active content. This is not a full antivirus scan.

disclosures.retention: The original file is kept in your Home Records until you remove it. Removing it moves it to the trash for 30 days, then it is deleted unless a retention rule or legal hold keeps it.
disclosures.sharing: Household members can see the file according to the sensitivity you choose. It is not shared outside your household.
disclosures.modelProcessing: To read a warranty, receipt, insurance policy or inspection report, the file is sent to Google Gemini, an AI service, to extract the details. Nothing is sent until you choose to read it.
disclosures.localProcessing: An appliance label photo is read on our server with text recognition. It is not sent to an AI service. The photo is kept as the original; the text it contains is kept for 7 days to build the draft.
disclosures.confirmation: Reading a file only proposes details. Nothing is added to your home until you accept it. Anything you reject, or leave undecided, is never added.
